    A seed that depends only on the ELF

    dot-elfSeed.Rd

    The SNLL threshold becomes thresh in runDEoptim(), so it is part of every cached DEoptim generation's key. Drawing the seed by chance meant a single cache miss on estimateThreshold re-drew the threshold and invalidated every cached generation for that ELF. Keyed on the ELF, a miss costs only the threshold estimate.

    .elfSeed(elf)

    Arguments

    elf

    character; sim$.ELFind (which falls back to sim$.runName).

    Value

    a single integer in 1:1e6.
